title: Jeff Bezos' ex-wife $30 mn donation gets 10 yr affordable housing plan in Bay Area
content: Housing Trust Silicon Valley has unveiled an ambitious 10-year initiative aimed at improving affordable housing in the Bay Area. With a generous $30 million backing from MacKenzie Scott, this plan seeks to bolster homeownership initiatives and forge stronger alliances with policy advocacy. The focus is on maximizing current funding and attracting new resources to create and maintain affordable housing for the community over the next decade.

title: Oregon landowner ordered to pay $810,000 after trees cut across property line
content: In an Oregon land dispute, a property owner accused their neighbor of intentionally clearing land past established boundaries. A jury sided with the plaintiff, awarding them $810,000 in damages. The court upheld this decision, indicating that the defendants failed to provide valid evidence to counter their liability, while also noting that Bosma was aware of the boundary issues before the clearing took place.

title: Why blue wave won't wash away US immigration, visa woes of Indians
content: As Democrats gain control of both chambers of Congress, they are poised to scrutinize immigration policies more closely. However, the enduring executive powers from the Trump era pose challenges for immediate reforms. Policy shifts will likely be dictated by court decisions instead of congressional mandates due to the presidential veto power.

title: Julia Child's former home sells for $6.525m; famous kitchen now in museum
content: Julia Child’s iconic home in Cambridge, Massachusetts, has found a new owner for $6.525 million. This historic residence, adored for its connection to Child's culinary shows, has seen extensive renovations. The original kitchen, however, remains untouched and is now a cherished exhibit at the Smithsonian Museum. To honor her legacy, a commemorative plaque is set to be installed at the site, ensuring that Child's influence on cooking continues.

title: Mumbai man shares tiny Rs 6,000 room where he lives with wife, three kids
content: In a heartfelt vlogging experience, a family of five showcases their life in a tiny Mumbai room, managing their daily activities on a modest budget of ₹6,000 monthly. The father elaborates on their clever sleeping arrangements to facilitate the children's education. This touching depiction of their living conditions has resonated with audiences online, igniting vital discussions about housing challenges faced in urban environments.

title: Florida's new tax rule puts billionaire bunkers in spotlight
content: Florida voters have given a green light to Amendment 3, a game-changing overhaul of property tax laws in the state. This will greatly enhance the homestead exemption, tripling it and providing crucial tax relief to average homeowners. However, for the ultra-wealthy with sprawling estates, the advantages of the exemption will seem rather insignificant.

title: Rats found on five of six islands in US seabird conservation survey
content: Recent surveys in the U.S. Virgin Islands have identified invasive species on several offshore cays. Black rats and green iguanas pose significant threats to local seabird populations, such as the red-billed tropicbird. Conservationists are now evaluating strategies to eradicate these non-native animals from the islands. Removal efforts could lead to improved nesting conditions for seabirds in the future. Successful initiatives may help restore these vital habitats for future generations.

title: Tyreek Hill’s NFL comeback faces major hurdle as teams assess his recovery
content: Tyreek Hill remains an unrestricted free agent after his release from the Miami Dolphins, making him available to sign with any NFL team without draft pick compensation. However, his return remains uncertain due to a serious knee injury suffered in 2025. Despite interest from playoff contenders, teams want complete medical clearance and private workouts before committing to the eight-time Pro Bowler.

title: Patrick and Brittany Mahomes help 60 young women find their dream dresses
content: In 2024, Patrick Mahomes and Brittany Mahomes' KC Current partnered with Nuuly and United Way of Greater Kansas City to donate nearly 100 designer dresses to local young women. The initiative welcomed 60 members of the Boys & Girls Clubs of Greater Kansas City, offering them outfits for special occasions. Players Hailie Mace, Gabrielle Robinson and Nichelle Prince also joined the event, which focused on confidence and self-expression.

title: Tanvi becomes first Indian woman to win Youth Olympics badminton medal
content: In a remarkable achievement at the Youth Olympic Games, Tanvi Patri has secured a historic silver medal in badminton, becoming the first Indian woman to earn a medal at the event. Competing fiercely, she reached the finals, facing off against China's Zhang Yi Xin. Although she narrowly missed out on victory, her unwavering spirit and determination shone through, amplifying India's growing reputation in the badminton arena.

title: Israel govt formation: In big setback for Netanyahu, Arab parties back Eisenkot
content: Israeli Arab parties are considering backing an opposition coalition to challenge Prime Minister Netanyahu’s leadership. Ahmad Tibi has expressed openness to support without formally joining the new government. This election has resulted in a fragmented Knesset lacking a decisive majority. Opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot has set specific conditions for engaging with Arab factions, marking a noteworthy evolution in the historical dynamics between Arab representatives and Israeli governance.

title: India eyes new $800m BrahMos deal as Philippines boosts defences against China
content: India is reportedly nearing a new defense deal with the Philippines for almost 60 BrahMos missiles. The potential agreement is estimated to be worth between $700 million to $800 million. Manila's interest comes as the country seeks to modernize its military and enhance coastal defenses against China. Philippine officials have conveyed their intention to acquire additional BrahMos missile systems from India.

title: Investors richer by Rs 29 lakh cr in 6 days, but will the market rally last?
content: The latest rally has extended the market's winning streak to six consecutive sessions. During this period, the Sensex has gained 6,063.98 points, or 8.27%, while the Nifty has advanced 1,837.75 points, which is an increase of 8%. Despite the recent recovery, the Nifty50 and Sensex remain down 6.1% and 6.9%, respectively, in 2026.

title: ‘Expect new dynamics’: Ukraine hopes for more support after Democrats sweep midterms
content: Ukraine anticipates enhanced military and financial assistance from the United States after the midterm elections. Foreign minister Andrii Sybiha expressed hope for new dynamics and support from the incoming Democratic majority. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy acknowledged the Democrats' vocal backing of Ukraine since their election success. This shift in power could enable legislation favoring aid to Ukraine despite previous limitations.

title: Jaypal Malviya secures India's first LA 2028 shooting quota with ISSF Worlds silver
content: Jaypal Malviya announced his talent by winning a silver medal at the ISSF World Championships. His performance earned India its first shooting quota for the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics. Malviya had qualified for the final in third place and showed resilience during tense moments. He previously made a mark by winning gold in national trials and has since equipped himself for future competitions.

title: They promised Afghan women freedom, delivered bans: Inside five years of Taliban rule
content: Under Taliban governance since August 2021, Afghanistan is grappling with severe rollbacks in women's rights and education. Over 2.6 million girls are deprived of secondary school education, and women's public engagement is significantly curtailed. The international community is alarmed by these developments, as restrictions on women’s employment further hinder access to healthcare. A report by UNESCO and UNICEF emphasizes the urgent decline in educational standards among Afghan youth.

title: Trump effect: US-based Indian techies are returning, but to what?
content: Techies returning from the US are getting into a wide range of tech and techno-functional roles across the board. Employers in India are also increasingly looking for specialised skills rather than treating international work experience as an advantage in itself. So, the important question then is: what are these techies returning to? Are there enough roles to absorb their talent? And, what about the salary levels?

title: India roar back from 0-1 down to beat Japan 4-1, clinch record sixth ACT title
content: India's hockey team clinched an impressive victory, capturing the men's Asian Champions Trophy against Japan. Despite falling behind initially, the players rallied to turn the tide, with Shilanand Lakra, Dilpreet Singh, Jugraj Singh, and Vivek Sagar Prasad each scoring vital goals. Japan's early lead was met with India's unwavering spirit, culminating in the team's sixth title in the tournament's history.

title: Kia dealer delays delivery of Rs 39L Carnival; commission awards Rs 2.33L to customer
content: After placing an order for a Kia Carnival, a company experienced significant setbacks when the dealer failed to deliver on time. This delay resulted in considerable financial losses. The commission found the dealer guilty of inadequate service while clearing Kia India of any blame. As a remedy, the dealer was mandated to return the booking fee with interest, plus cover legal fees and compensation for the impacted company.

title: Vivek Ramaswamy and Zohran Mamdani: A tale of two Indian-Americans
content: Dickens wrote of the spring of hope and the winter of despair as two seasons belonging to the same age. The American electorate witnessed both in November 2026. Mamdani chose hope. Ramaswamy chose despair. And the results suggested which had proved more persuasive.

title: UP teen calls child helpline to stop her marriage to 25-yr-old Saudi Arabia-based man
content: A 16-year-old girl in Ballia intervened to stop her arranged marriage to a 25-year-old man. The girl contacted the Child Helpline, revealing her underage status and impending wedding. Officials, accompanied by local police, assisted in counseling her family regarding the legal ramifications of child marriage. After discussions, both families agreed to cancel the wedding and signed undertakings to comply with the law.

title: 'Memory of the World': Rajatarangini, Mahabharata & Arthashastra get UN recognition
content: Three significant works from India's literary heritage have been added to Unesco's Memory of the World Regional Register. Kalhana's 'Rajatarangini', the 'Mahabharata', and Kautilya's 'Arthashastra' received this recognition recently. These inscriptions reflect various aspects of India's intellectual traditions, including historical writing and governance. This announcement follows India's previous regional register recognitions in 2024 for other literary works. The initiative aims to preserve and digitise India's manuscript heritage for future generations.

title: What I have learnt is that I should not think so much ahead: Prithvi Shaw
content: Prithvi Shaw scored an unbeaten 53 runs to guide Maharashtra to a 10-wicket win over Bengal. After shifting from Mumbai, he enjoys leading Maharashtra in the Ranji Trophy match. Shaw emphasised the importance of focusing on immediate tasks rather than thinking ahead about his return to the national team. He expressed confidence in achieving big runs with more consistent performances in forthcoming innings.

title: Over 500 Bank Accounts Frozen, 2,000 Arrested In Drug Crackdown In J&K

title: 119 warships & counting: Kolkata-based GRSE delivers fifth submarine-hunter to Navy
content: 'Amini' is the fifth of the eight anti-submarine warfare shallow water craft . the 119th warship built by GRSE and the 81st warship delivered to the navy . 'amini' has the ability to undertake comprehensive sub-surface surveillance, search and attack missions . it is capable of detecting, tracking and engaging underwater threats .

title: Iraq airspace reopens, Air India restores nonstop US flights, cuts Rome detours
content: air India has made its flights between Delhi/Mumbai and new york nonstop since Wednesday . the airline's operations team, like that of other carriers, does constantly analyses enroute geopolitical situation . as soon as the risk rating for Iraq, Syria and Jordan reduced, it has started getting a slightly shorter route available . now the journeys become 15-16 hours, instead of the almost 20 hours they took with the Rome stop .

title: California governor commutes death sentences of 548 death row inmates
content: governor Gavin Newsom has moved to commute the death sentences of all 548 inmates on the state's death row to life imprisonment without the possibility of parole . but the California Supreme Court will have the final say in 382 of the cases . the decision comes as Newsom prepares to leave office after eight years .
